title: The servers' instructions are the same in every prompt of every turn: Tool Search does not hide them, and neither a result's eviction nor a compaction between two rounds reaches them
notes: Python: channels/_ai_context.py, tests/test_mcp_server_instructions.py::test_tool_search_leaves_them_in_the_prompt; roomkit-rs: roomkit-ai channel.rs. The agent runs Tool Search, which hides its unpinned tools; a call's result past its eviction threshold reaches the model as a preview to read back with read_stored_result; and its memory compacts the history between the two rounds of the first turn; a second turn follows. Every request's system prompt is the same text, which holds the agent's own prompt then the servers' block (read on the first turn's generation hook). Not observed: what a provider caches, which the corpus's models do not.
